tracking: ADR-0261 (P37): the owner decided on 2026-11-07 to ship the DefenseClaw ingest API-only, with the admin screen tracked on #453

gaps.GET /v1/third-party-ingest/sources: lists third-party ingest sources (DefenseClaw), their state, credential issue time and the ingest limits
gaps.POST /v1/third-party-ingest/sources: creates a DefenseClaw ingest source, off by default
gaps.PUT /v1/third-party-ingest/sources/:sour: turns a source on (step-up, audited) or off (audited)
gaps.POST /v1/third-party-ingest/sources/:sou: issues or replaces the source's write-only rgti_ token, shown once (step-up, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/third-party-ingest/sources/:sour: the newest third-party evidence a source delivered, each marked third-party with its linked findings
